description: This file defines the LeaveTypeLeaveEntitlementUsageReport class, which implements a report for leave entitlement and usage data within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It specifies report headers, filters, data retrieval logic, validation rules, and access controls related to leave types and employee leave records.

classes.name: LeaveTypeLeaveEntitlementUsageReport
classes.description: This class implements a report for leave entitlement and usage data, defining report headers, filters, validation, data retrieval, and access control mechanisms.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Returns the header configuration for the report, defining columns such as Employee Name, Leave Entitlements, Pending Approval, Scheduled, Taken, and Balance in Days.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns an empty Filter object for report filtering options.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Retrieves report data based on the provided filter parameters by instantiating LeaveTypeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportData.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares and populates filter parameters from the API request, including employee access, leave type, job title, subunit, location, and date range.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Defines validation rules for request parameters, ensuring entity IDs exist and date formats are correct.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Determines if the current user has permission to access the report; throws ForbiddenException if not.
